trace.question: how many open count are there?

task_results.sql:
SELECT
    
    COALESCE(SUM(r.open_count),0)::bigint AS total_opens

FROM campaign.campaign_send_recipients r
JOIN campaign.campaign_send_batches b ON b.id = r.batch_id
JOIN (
SELECT
  c.id,
  c.organization_id,
  c.branch_id,
  c.name,
  c.description,
  c.status,
  c.starts_at,
  c.ends_at,
  c.source_channel,
  c.created_by_user_id,
  c.created_at,
  c.updated_at,
  c.goal,
  c.objective,
  c.session_id,
  c.audience_summary,
  c.audience_count,
  c.launch_plan,
  c.launch_local_date,
  c.launch_local_time,
  c.timezone
FROM campaign.campaigns c
WHERE c.organization_id = 1012
  AND c.branch_id = 1004

) campaigns ON campaigns.id = r.campaign_id
WHERE r.organization_id = 1012
  AND campaigns.branch_id = 1004
  AND TRUE
  AND TRUE
  AND TRUE
